name: Pipeline run status and duration
def: Shows a pipeline run, its status (e.g., passed, failed, awaiting approval) and how long it took

name: Workflow (name, status, duration)
def: A workflow groups the jobs in a run and the order they run in. Shows whether its status (e.g., passed, failed, awaiting approval) and how long it took

name: Job (name, status, duration)
def: A job is a set of steps that run together. Shows whether its status (e.g., passed, failed, awaiting approval) and how long it took

name: Parallel executions
def: The number of instances a job runs at the same time

name: Pipeline name
def: The name of the pipeline, which defines where your configuration is stored and where your code is checked out from

name: Pipeline ID
def: A unique identifier for the pipeline

name: Project
def: The project that runs this code

name: Project settings link
ex: an icon or menu to access settings
def: A link to get to settings and configuration that apply to the project, such as project-level environment variables and integrations

name: Repo
def: The code repository the project's code comes from

name: Commit SHA
def: Short ID of the commit the run used

name: Commit message
def: The message written for the commit

name: Branch
def: The branch the run was triggered on

name: Tag
def: The git tag that started the run

name: Trigger
def: What happened to start the run, such as a tag push

name: Pushed by
def: The person whose action started the run

name: Start time
def: When the run began

name: Finish time
def: When the run finished

name: Approval button
def: A manual gate for a job that pauses the workflow until someone with permission approves it

name: Rerun button
def: Button to run a failed workflow again without starting a new pipeline run

name: Cancel button
def: Button to cancel a workflow

name: Fix workflow action
def: A button that lets you copy a prompt describing the failure to paste into an AI tool of your choice, or fix it with AI directly

name: Test failure details
def: A summary of which tests failed and where
